market.title: Exclusive: Full list of attendees at White House AI lunch
market.summary: A host of industry titans and Washington power players are slated to meet with President Trump and House Speaker Mike Johnson on Tuesday for a crucial meeting on AI as calls for government intervention mount. Why it matters: The Trump administration wants to take a hands off approach and rely on the industry's own expertise to set guardrails. A list of RSVPs obtained by Axios shows 31 confirmed attendees for lunch at the summit — spanning industry and key government officials. What's inside: White House Chief of Staff Susie Wiles, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, White House Deputy Chief of Staff Richard Walters and White House counsel Will Scharf will attend. Craft Ventures' David Sacks, former White House AI czar, will attend. Palo Alto Networks CEO Nikesh Arora, Amazon founder Jeff Bezos, Altimeter CEO Brad Gerstner, ServiceNow CEO Bill McDermott, Micron CEO Sanjay Mehrotra and Elon Musk will attend. So will Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella, Social Capital founder Chamath Palihapitiya, Exiger CEO Brandon Rahbar Daniels, Palantir CTO Shyam Sankar, AMD CEO Lisa Su, Broadcom CEO Hock Tan. The CEOs of Meta, Nvidia, Palantir, Google and Anthropic will attend, as previously reported. OpenAI President Greg Brockman will attend while CEO Sam Altman attends the company's annual conference in San Francisco. Other government officials who will attend include: Vice President JD Vance, Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick, NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman, White House science adviser Michael Kratsios. Also: National Cyber Director Sean Cairncross and National Intelligence Director Jay Clayton. The bottom line: Expect a flashy gathering of the world's most powerful officials and executives but few specifics on regulation.

Combined with an 8,000 tonne agreement with LG Energy Solution, the project now has 20,000 tonnes of committed offtake, exceeding its 80% capacity target and enabling the company to proceed with finalizing $1.1 billion in debt financing. First commercial production is targeted for 2029.

KBR.title: KBR and Trinzic to Host Separate Investor Days in New York City
KBR.summary: KBR announced that it will host separate Investor Day events in November 2026 for itself and Trinzic, the planned spin-off of its Mission Technology Solutions business. KBR's Investor Day is scheduled for November 11, 2026, while Trinzic's will be held on November 12, 2026. Trinzic is expected to launch as an independent public company in January 2027 with over $5 billion in annual revenue and 18,000 employees.

HEINY.title: Heineken N.V. reports the progress of transactions under its current share buyback programme
HEINY.summary: Heineken N.V. reported the completion of 164,417 shares repurchased on exchange and 164,949 shares from Heineken Holding N.V. during September 21-25, 2026. As of September 25, 2026, the company has repurchased 7,847,104 shares under the second tranche of its €1.5 billion buyback programme for €556.8 million at an average price of €71.27 per share.

VTAK.title: Flyte Named Official Air Travel Partner of the 34th Annual Hamptons International Film Festival
VTAK.summary: Flyte, a subsidiary of Catheter Precision, Inc., has been named the Official Air Travel Partner of the 34th annual Hamptons International Film Festival (October 2-12, 2026). As a Lead Sponsor, Flyte will sponsor multiple festival programs including the World Cinema Narrative section and the 2026 Breakthrough Awards, which will honor emerging talent including Anthony Ippolito, Rosalind Eleazar, and Jordan Firstman. The partnership reflects Flyte's growing presence in the Hamptons market for regional private aviation.

ZYME.title: Zymeworks Announces Updated 2026 Financial Guidance and Final Transaction Details Following Theravance Biopharma Acquisition
ZYME.summary: Zymeworks completed its acquisition of Theravance Biopharma, adding YUPELRI to its portfolio and providing durable cash flows. The company updated 2026 guidance to $278-292 million in total revenue and $114-128 million in Adjusted EBITDA. The acquisition is expected to deliver mid-teens IRR with immediate accretive revenue and cash flow, financed through a $350 million non-recourse note from OMERS and $217.5 million in existing cash.

ABT.summary: The global Therapeutic Drug Monitoring (TDM) consumables market is projected to grow from USD 364.27 million in 2026 to USD 586.85 million by 2032, driven by an 8.22% CAGR. AEXAY.summary: Atos announces the appointment of Paul Potgieter as Head of Middle East & Türkiye operations. AFGVY.title: EFI and Agfa’s DPS Business to Combine  and Form a Global, Full-Service Industrial Inkjet Company
AFGVY.summary: Electronics for Imaging, Inc. (EFI) and Agfa-Gevaert announced a definitive agreement to combine Agfa's Digital Printing Solutions business with EFI. Siris will hold 60% and Agfa will hold 40% of the jointly held company. The combined entity is expected to generate approximately €540 million ($625 million) in 2026 revenue, serving customers across more than 100 countries with complementary geographic strengths and anticipated significant synergies.

AFGVY.title: Agfa-Gevaert NV verlengt doorlopende kredietfaciliteit
AFGVY.summary: Agfa-Gevaert NV has extended its revolving credit facility of €180 million until August 1, 2030, two years beyond the previous expiration date of August 1, 2028. The facility will be used for working capital and general corporate purposes, with financial covenants including a maximum leverage ratio of 3.0 and minimum interest coverage ratio of 4.0. The facility is now secured by a pledge on Agfa HealthCare shares and is organized by a consortium of four Belgian banks.

AFGVY.title: Siris neemt het belang van 19,1% van Active Ownership in Agfa-Gevaert NV over
AFGVY.summary: Siris Capital Group has agreed to acquire a 19.1% stake in Agfa-Gevaert NV from Active Ownership as part of a strategic investment. The transaction is contingent on the completion of the previously announced merger between Agfa's Digital Printing Solutions business and Electronics for Imaging, Inc. (EFI), a Siris portfolio company. Siris plans to serve as a constructive shareholder supporting Agfa's growth and ongoing transformation.

AFGVY.title: EFI en de DPS-activiteiten van Agfa worden samengevoegd in een wereldwijd opererende, full-service onderneming op het gebied van industriële inkjettechnologie
AFGVY.summary: Electronics for Imaging (EFI) and Agfa-Gevaert's Digital Printing Solutions (DPS) division are merging to create a global full-service industrial inkjet technology company. Siris will hold 60% ownership while Agfa retains 40% in the joint venture. The combined entity is expected to generate approximately €540 million in 2026 pro forma revenue, serving thousands of customers across 100+ countries with complementary geographic strengths and anticipated significant synergies.

AFGVY.title: Siris to Acquire 19.1% Stake in Agfa-Gevaert
AFGVY.summary: Siris Capital Group announced a strategic investment acquiring a 19.1% ownership stake in Agfa-Gevaert NV, following the previously announced agreement to combine Agfa's Digital Printing Solutions business with EFI (a Siris portfolio company). The combined inkjet business will be 60% owned by Siris and 40% by Agfa. The investment deepens Siris's exposure to both the combined EFI-Agfa DPS business and Agfa's HealthCare IT business, which is experiencing double-digit recurring revenue growth.

AFGVY.title: Agfa-Gevaert NV extends revolving credit facility
AFGVY.summary: Agfa-Gevaert NV has extended its 180 million euro revolving credit facility maturity from August 1, 2028 to August 1, 2030. The facility includes financial covenants for leverage ratio (max 3.0), interest coverage ratio (min 4.0), and liquidity headroom (min 30 million euro). The facility is now secured by a pledge of Agfa HealthCare shares and arranged by four financial institutions.
